description: This file defines the NotesList activity for an Android note-taking app. It displays a list of note titles, handles menu options for adding, pasting, editing, copying, and deleting notes, manages context menus for list items, and implements LoaderCallbacks to asynchronously load data from the content provider.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: An activity that displays a list of note titles, allowing users to view, edit, copy, delete, or add notes using menus and context menus.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list adapter with cursor loader, and sets context menu listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu, adds intent-based alternative actions for other apps.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Enables/disables menu items based on clipboard content and list contents.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu actions such as adding and pasting notes.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates context menu for list items, with options for open/edit, copy, delete.

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Performs actions like open/edit, copy URI to clipboard, delete note based on context menu choice.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Responds to clicks on list items, opening or returning a note URI depending on action.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to asynchronously load note data.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates the adapter with the loaded cursor.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the adapter cursor when loader is reset.
